description: Generate a comprehensive Product Requirements Document (PRD) for an AINative feature, integration, or product. Uses AI with full AINative platform context — knows all services, APIs, SDKs, and architectural constraints. The PRD is automatically saved to ZeroMemory for cross-session recall.

additional_context.description: Any additional context, links, or requirements

ainative_services.description: AINative services this feature will use (e.g., ["ZeroDB", "ZeroMemory", "Agent Cloud"]). If omitted, the generator will auto-detect relevant services.

core_features.description: List of core features to include

description.description: Detailed description of what needs to be built

issue_number.description: Optional GitHub issue number to link to

product_name.description: Name of the product or feature

name: prd_generate
